definitions.explanation: A coin made of silver or a coin with silver content. Composed of 銀 (silver) + 貨 (currency/coin). Used in historical, numismatic, and literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{銀貨|ぎんか}を{集|あつ}めている。
{博物館|はくぶつかん}には{江戸時代|えどじだい}の{銀貨|ぎんか}が{展示|てんじ}されていた。
examples.english: Silver coins from the Edo period were on display at the museum.

examples.japanese: この{銀貨|ぎんか}は{保存状態|ほぞんじょうたい}がよく、コレクターの{間|あいだ}で{高値|たかね}で{取引|とりひき}されている。
examples.english: This silver coin is in excellent condition and trades at a high price among collectors.

notes:
USAGE:
{銀貨|ぎんか} appears frequently in historical contexts, fairy tales, and discussions of numismatics. In modern Japan, coins are made of various alloys rather than pure silver.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀貨|ぎんか}を{集|あつ}める (collect silver coins)
- {記念|きねん}{銀貨|ぎんか} (commemorative silver coin)

RELATED WORDS:
- {金貨|きんか} (gold coin)
- {銅貨|どうか} (copper coin)
- {硬貨|こうか} (coin, general term)
- {貨幣|かへい} (currency, money)
